notes.subject: העניק תעניק
notes.rationale: Infinitive absolute irait olsem wankain tok tupela taim — 'mas givim, i tru givim' — lukim ol man i tanim tok i pulapim 'liberally'

notes.subject: mas givim gutpela tru
notes.rationale: ענק i min 'putim nekles'; Inglis 'furnish liberally' i lusim piksa bilong nekles

translation: Yupela mas givim gutpela tru long em: long ol sipsip na meme bilong yu, na long graun bilong pundaum bilong yu, na long pondo wain bilong yu; olsem Yahwe Elohim bilong yu bin barekim yu, olsem yu givim long em.

tokens.gloss: long ol sipsip na meme bilong yu
na long graun bilong pundaum bilong yu
na long pondo wain bilong yu
